summary: Lion Group Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing approval of a share capital reduction and reorganization. Shareholders approved on July 13, 2026; filed with ROC on July 21, 2026; approval on September 2, 2026, effective retroactively to July 21, 2026. Authorized capital now US$20,000,000 divided into 200,000,000,000,000 ordinary shares, comprising Class A, Class B, and preferred shares. This corporate action adjusts capital structure, not a routine event. What to watch: operational implications from the share reorganization.
